rules.name: Require production inputs before compilation
rules.enforcement: Require approved Film Bible, active approved assets, reference manifest, START/MID/END, camera, lighting, dialogue when needed, sound, and negative rules.

rules.name: References control visual truth
rules.enforcement: Text controls events, timing, performance, camera, and movement; approved references control locked visual identity.

rules.name: Use targeted continuity negatives
rules.enforcement: Include relevant protections for duplicate identities, drift, wardrobe, morphing, extra people, blended architecture, missing props, wound reset, teleportation, camera reversal, and time or light jumps.

rules.name: Inspect every generation
rules.enforcement: Compare output with reference manifest and START/MID/END states; reject visually impressive results that violate locks.

rules.name: Clean masters outrank generated frames
rules.enforcement: A flawed last frame or video may never overwrite a clean locked identity or asset reference.
